accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Selection rings, focus and the terminal cursor.

dock.label: Hide the dock
dock.description: The bar under a canvas or drawing hides until the pointer nears the bottom edge.

language.label: Language
language.description: System follows your OS, and falls back to English for a language Ruimte does not speak yet.

interface.label: Interface font
interface.description: Falls back to the system font if it is not installed.

interfaceSize.label: Interface font size
interfaceSize.description: Scales text and spacing everywhere except terminals and code.

mono.label: Monospace font
mono.description: For terminals and code. Falls back to the system font if it is not installed.

terminalLineHeight.label: Terminal line height
terminalLineHeight.description: As a multiple of the row height the font needs.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Choose which projects appear in the sidebar and Needs attention, across all your machines.

needsYou.label: Needs you from every open project
needsYou.description: Also list what waits for you in your other open projects, grouped by project.

size.label: Code font size
size.description: Code and diffs in files, the editor and the git panel. Chats keep their own size. The font itself is under Appearance.

lineHeight.label: Code line height
lineHeight.description: As a multiple of the code font size, rounded to whole pixels. Applies wherever code is drawn.

ligatures.label: Ligatures
ligatures.description: Draws => and !== as one symbol in files, the editor, diffs and chats.

wrap.label: Wrap long lines
wrap.description: In files, the editor and diffs.

indentGuides.label: Indent guides
indentGuides.description: A line at each indentation level in the editor, with the one around the cursor stronger.

whitespace.label: Show whitespace
whitespace.description: Spaces as dots and tabs as arrows in the editor.

rightMargin.label: Right margin
rightMargin.description: A line at the column set by max_line_length in the project's .editorconfig. Off for a project without one.

camelHumps.label: Camel humps
camelHumps.description: Moving by word also stops inside camelCase and snake_case words.

usages.label: Usages
usages.description: Shows how many times a class, function or method is used, above its declaration. Press it to see where.

authors.label: Authors
authors.description: Shows above a class, function or method who wrote it according to git, with a plus for other authors. Press it for the commits.

inlineAgent.label: Inline edit
inlineAgent.description: The agent that handles inline edits, and the account it runs under when you have more than one. It runs as a chat in the project.

agentChanges.label: Agent changes in open files
agentChanges.description: How edits from a running chat appear in the editor.

attribution.label: Attribution in gutter
attribution.description: Marks the lines an agent wrote. Hover shows the chat and the turn.

help.label: Explain and name suggestions
help.description: Uses Apple Foundation Models on this Mac. Code is not sent anywhere.

ghost.label: Suggestions while typing
ghost.description: Ghost text from the on-device model, two to three seconds per suggestion.

outline.title: Outline
outline.label: Show fold arrows
outline.description: The arrows in the gutter that fold and open a block. A folded block always shows its marker in the text.

general.title: Fold by default
general.description: What folds when a file opens for the first time. A file you folded or opened yourself keeps what you left. Bodies come from the language servers, so they fold once those have answered.

fileHeader.label: File header
fileHeader.description: The comment at the top of a file, such as a license.

imports.label: Imports
imports.description: The run of import lines at the top.

methodBodies.label: Function and method bodies
methodBodies.description: What sits between the braces, with the signature left in view. PHP has its own switches.

customRegions.label: Custom regions
customRegions.description: What sits between // region and // endregion.

objectLiterals.label: Object literals
objectLiterals.description: Objects written out as a value, such as after an equals sign or in a call.

arrayLiterals.label: Array literals
arrayLiterals.description: Arrays written out as a value.

xmlLiterals.label: JSX elements
xmlLiterals.description: Elements that span several lines, once the language server has answered.

php.title: PHP
php.description: Imports, documentation comments and the file header follow the switches above. Bodies come from the language server.

tags.label: PHP tags
tags.description: Blocks of PHP between markup, from <?php to ?>, other than the one that opens the file.

heredocs.label: Heredocs and nowdocs
heredocs.description: Text blocks up to their closing line.

methodBodies.label: Method bodies
methodBodies.description: Methods of a class, interface, trait or enum.

classBodies.label: Class bodies
classBodies.description: Everything between the braces of a class, interface, trait or enum.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: An attribute list that spans several lines.

markup.title: HTML and XML
markup.description: For HTML, XML, Vue and Svelte, once the language server has answered.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: What folds in a Markdown file. The section under a heading folds by hand.

frontMatter.label: Front matter
frontMatter.description: The block between --- lines at the top.

pairBrackets.label: Pair brackets
pairBrackets.description: Typing ( [ or { adds the closing bracket, and typing it goes over it.

pairQuotes.label: Pair quotes
pairQuotes.description: Typing a quote adds the closing one.

surroundSelection.label: Surround selection
surroundSelection.description: Typing a bracket or quote over a selection wraps it.

tabOut.label: Tab out of closers
tabOut.description: Tab steps over a bracket or quote the editor added.

smartEnter.label: Smart indent on Enter
smartEnter.description: Enter indents the new line, continues comments and closes braces.

indentOnPaste.label: Indent on paste
indentOnPaste.description: A pasted block moves to the indentation of the line it lands on.

smartSemicolon.label: Smart semicolon
smartSemicolon.description: A semicolon typed inside a call goes to the end of the statement.

servers.title: Language servers
servers.needsProject: Open a project to manage its language servers. A server is installed once per machine and runs per project.
servers.description: Installed once on the machine, started per project when a file needs it.
servers.failed: The language servers failed to render

own.title: Your own servers
own.description: A language server you run yourself. Ruimte starts exactly the command you save, for the files it serves.
own.empty: No servers of your own yet.
own.removeDescription: Ruimte stops it wherever it runs. The program itself stays on this machine.

dialog.description: Saving starts exactly this command on this machine for the files it serves, and again whenever a project needs it. Change the command and you save it again.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.commandHint: An absolute path, or a program that is on the PATH of this machine.
dialog.commandMissing: Not found on this machine. Give an absolute path.
dialog.argsHint: One per line. The server talks over stdio.
dialog.languagesHint: Language ids, such as zig or toml, separated by commas.
dialog.patternsHint: One per line, such as *.zig or templates/**. Without a slash it matches the file name anywhere.
dialog.optionsHint: Initialization options as JSON. Leave empty for none.
dialog.failed: The server could not be saved

problem.name: Give the server a name.
problem.serves: Name a language or a file pattern it serves.
problem.pattern: One of the file patterns is not valid. Check its braces.
problem.options: The options are not valid JSON.

light.label: Light theme
light.description: The colors of code while the app is light, in files, the editor and chats.

dark.label: Dark theme
dark.description: The colors of code while the app is dark.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, accent, the terminal font and the region numbers and dates are written in.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: The code editor: its font, wrapping and smart keys, and the language servers behind it.

views.label: Views
views.description: How drawings and browser pages behave.

files.label: Files and Git
files.description: What the Files and Git panels show, and where browsing for a folder starts.

agents.label: Agents
agents.description: Defaults, permissions and notifications for agents.

computer.label: Computer Use
computer.description: Let agents operate the apps on a computer. They only reach an app after you allow it.

machines.label: Account
machines.description: Your Ruimte account, the machines on it, and how each one is reached.

snap.label: Snap to the grid
snap.description: Shapes land on the 8 unit grid when you draw, move or resize them. Freehand strokes never snap.

swipe.label: Swipe between pages
swipe.description: Two fingers left or right on the trackpad go back or forward in a browser node or view. A page that scrolls sideways itself keeps the gesture.

openFiles.label: Open files
openFiles.description: Past this number, the oldest unpinned tab closes. Double-click a tab to pin it.

hidden.label: Show hidden and ignored files
hidden.description: What git ignores, build output such as node_modules, and dotfiles in a folder without a repository. Files the operating system keeps to itself stay hidden either way.

browseStart.label: Start browsing in
browseStart.description: The folder the command palette starts in when you browse. Applies to every machine. Empty or missing falls back to the home folder.

layout.label: Diff layout
layout.description: Stacked shows one column. Split puts the old and new versions side by side.

whitespace.label: Show whitespace changes
whitespace.description: Off hides changes that only touch whitespace, in the diff and in the counts.

selection.title: Selection
selection.escape: Clear the selection, or leave the node you are in

views.title: Views
views.rename: Rename a node, or open the settings of a view

split.title: Split
split.right: Split the cell to the right
split.focusNeighbor: Focus the neighboring cell (any arrow key)
split.maximize: Maximize the selected node or the focused cell, or restore it

drawing.title: Drawing
drawing.keepTool: Keep the tool selected after drawing

launches.title: Launches
launches.run: Launch the chosen launch, or restart it

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.answerFront: Answer the front prompt of the canvas

chat.title: Chat
chat.dictation: Dictate: tap to toggle, hold to talk

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.nextNode: Move focus to the next node
nodes.select: Select the node the keyboard is on
nodes.escape: Clear the selection (a terminal passes Escape to its program)

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.clear: Clear the screen and the scrollback
terminal.lineStart: Move to the beginning of the line
terminal.lineEnd: Move to the end of the line
terminal.deleteToLineStart: Delete to the beginning of the line

keyboard.browserNote: In a browser tab, {{newView}} and {{closeCell}} belong to the browser.

backgroundService.title: When Ruimte quits

keepRunning.label: Keep this machine running when Ruimte quits
keepRunning.description: Sessions and agents keep working in the background, so this machine stays reachable from your other clients and the web.

unavailable.dev: The dev app always runs a machine of its own and stops it when it quits.
unavailable.windows: Not available on Windows yet, so this machine stops when Ruimte quits.
unavailable.appimage: Not available for the AppImage, which is gone once Ruimte quits. Install the deb or rpm package to keep this machine running.
unavailable.commandLine: This machine runs as the background service that `npx ruimte service install` set up. Ruimte uses it as it is and leaves it alone; `npx ruimte service uninstall` removes it.

pending.takeOver: Ruimte runs this machine itself right now. It keeps running from the next time Ruimte quits.
pending.handBack: This machine stops when Ruimte quits.

backgroundService.failure: The background service did not run this machine: {{reason}}

linger.label: Keep running after you log out
linger.on: Lingering is on, so this machine keeps running after you log out.
linger.off: Without it, this machine stops when you log out of your desktop session.

stop.label: Stop the machine
stop.description: Ends every session here and quits Ruimte. The machine starts again the next time you open Ruimte.

confirmStop.title: Stop this machine and quit Ruimte?
confirmStop.description: Every terminal and agent on this machine ends, and no other client can reach it until you open Ruimte again.

confirmRestart.title: Restart this machine now?
confirmRestart.description: Every terminal and agent on this machine ends, and it comes back on the updated version.

confirmLinger.title: Keep running after you log out?
confirmLinger.description: Ruimte runs loginctl enable-linger for your user, so your user services keep running without a session. Undo it with loginctl disable-linger.

deleteAnyView.label: Agents may delete any view or node
deleteAnyView.rowLabel: Agents on {{machine}} may delete any view or node
deleteAnyView.description: Off, an agent only deletes views and nodes it created. On, it can delete any view or node in any project there, including yours.
deleteAnyView.notConnected: Not connected. Change this from the machine's dialog under Account, or while a project on it is open.

resumeAtReset.label: Chats resume after a limit
resumeAtReset.rowLabel: Chats on {{machine}} resume after a limit
resumeAtReset.description: On, a chat that stopped on a usage limit goes on by itself once the limit resets, and a turn that failed because the model was overloaded is tried again after 1, 5 and 15 minutes.
resumeAtReset.notConnected: Not connected. Change this while a project on the machine is open.

visualReplies.label: Visual replies
visualReplies.rowLabel: Agents on {{machine}} may show visual replies
visualReplies.description: On, an agent may show a chart, table or mockup above its reply, as a page. Off, it answers in text. Visuals already in a chat stay.
visualReplies.notConnected: Not connected. Change this while a project on the machine is open.

machine.title: On {{machine}}
machine.description: Saved per machine. Applies to every client connected to it.

defaults.title: Defaults for new agents
defaults.description: Applies to every provider. The model and account of each CLI are set under <link>Providers</link>.

sound.label: Play a sound with a notification

battery.label: Also on battery
battery.description: Off, this computer only stays awake on the power adapter.

display.label: Keep the display on
display.description: Off, the display can still turn off while the computer stays awake.
display.needsBattery: Only together with Also on battery, since macOS cannot keep the display on for the power adapter alone.

lid.label: Also with the lid closed
lid.description: Turns sleep off while keep awake holds, so the Mac keeps running with its lid shut. Sleep comes back as soon as keep awake lets go or the machine stops. On battery it holds only with Also on battery, and lets go below {{percent}}. Without this, a closed lid sleeps the Mac unless an external display and the power adapter are connected.
lid.search: Keep the Mac running with its lid shut while keep awake holds.

rule.label: Permission on this Mac
rule.missing: Adds a rule to /etc/sudoers.d that lets Ruimte run pmset -a disablesleep 1 and 0 without a password, and nothing else. macOS asks for an administrator password first.
rule.installed: A rule in /etc/sudoers.d lets Ruimte run pmset -a disablesleep 1 and 0 without a password, and nothing else. Removing it turns sleep back on and the switch above off.

prompt.install: Ruimte wants to let this Mac stay awake with its lid closed. It adds a rule that lets it turn sleep off and on again, and nothing else.
prompt.remove: Ruimte wants to remove the rule that lets it keep this Mac awake with its lid closed.

keepAwake.saveFailed: Keep awake could not be changed

words.label: Word by word
words.description: Follows the agent as it writes.

blocks.label: Paragraph by paragraph
blocks.description: Shows each paragraph once it is complete.

whole.label: When complete
whole.description: Waits until the reply is done.

showViews.label: Let an agent show you a view
showViews.description: On, a view an agent opens replaces the one you are working in, and a banner takes you back. Off, the banner offers a button to go there.

machine.label: Machine
machine.description: The machine of the current workspace, and its version.

dataFolder.label: Data folder
dataFolder.description: Where the machine stores sessions, chats and worktrees.

auto.label: Download updates automatically
auto.description: On, new versions download in the background. Off, you start each download yourself.

report.label: Report a problem
report.description: Describe what you saw and what you expected.

key.title: Voice Control
key.sectionDescription: Control your workspace by speaking. Uses OpenAI GPT-Live and sends audio to OpenAI only during an active conversation. Requires your own API key.
key.label: API key
key.desktopOnly: API keys can be configured in the Ruimte desktop app.
key.persistent: Encrypted with this computer's keychain. Ruimte never shows the saved value again.
key.session: Encryption is unavailable, so this key is kept only until Ruimte quits.
key.missing: Required for GPT-Live. The key stays in the desktop shell and is never stored in a project.
key.saveFailure: The API key could not be saved.
key.readFailure: The settings could not be read.
key.removeFailure: The API key could not be removed.

toast.saveFailed: Could not save the API key
toast.removeFailed: Could not remove the API key

microphone.unavailableHint: Uses the system default until it returns

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: Changes apply when you start the next conversation. Only an active conversation sends microphone audio to OpenAI.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: Input used for dictation and Voice Control.
microphone.unavailableDescription: Microphones could not be listed. The system default is used.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language for dictation and Voice Control. Some languages are only available in Voice Control.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: OpenAI's built-in Live voices. Marin and Cedar are recommended.

confirm.label: Confirm deletions
confirm.description: Ask before Voice Control deletes views or nodes. When off, spoken deletion requests run immediately.

input.title: Microphone and language
input.description: Shared by Speech to Text and Voice Control. Changes apply to the next recording.

computer.description: Agents can see and operate the apps on a computer. They only reach an app after you allow it.

machine.notConnected: Not connected. Change this from the machine's dialog under Account, or while a project on it is open.
machine.unsupported: Computer Use is not available for this machine's system yet.
machine.unavailable: This machine has no Ruimte Computer Use. It comes with the Ruimte desktop app.
machine.off: Off. Agents on this machine cannot see or operate its apps.
machine.ready: On. An agent asks you before it uses an app.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Lets agents read and press what is on the screen.

screenRecording.label: Screen Recording
screenRecording.description: Lets agents see a picture of the window they work in.

computer.restartNote: Screen Recording takes effect once Ruimte Computer Use starts again. Ruimte restarts it when you come back to this window.
computer.remote: Allow these on {{machine}} itself, in System Settings > Privacy & Security.

apps.alwaysEmpty: No apps are allowed for always.
apps.terminalsEmpty: No apps have been seen running a shell.
apps.notTerminalHint: An agent asks for it again. If it runs a shell, it counts as a terminal again.

identity.name: Name
identity.nameHint: Leave empty to use the default name.
identity.gone: That machine is no longer in the list
identity.saveFailed: The machine could not save the change

machine.notAnswering: Not answering. Change this once the machine is back.
machine.unsupported: This machine runs a version without this setting.
machine.unsupportedReason: This machine runs a version without this setting

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Connect over WebRTC instead of the socket (experimental).

broker.label: Broker
broker.description: How a signed-in client finds the machine without its address. {{where}}{{fixed}}
broker.fixed: Set when the machine started, so this choice waits until it runs without that.

lanDoor.label: Local network
lanDoor.search: Lets a client on the same network connect to the machine without the broker.
lanDoor.open: A client on the same network connects here without the broker. Open on {{addresses}}.
lanDoor.noAddress: Open on port {{port}}, but the machine has no address on a local network right now.
lanDoor.notListening: Not open right now: the port is taken, or the machine started without it.
lanDoor.closed: Closed. Every client reaches this machine through the broker.
lanDoor.fixed: Set by a flag when the machine started, so this switch waits until it runs without that
lanDoor.fixedNote: Set by a flag when the machine started, so this switch waits until it runs without that.
lanDoor.toggle: Let a client on the local network reach {{machine}} without the broker

streaming.label: Browser and device streaming
streaming.description: Allow this machine to stream browser pages and device screens to clients without a native view of their own.
streaming.toggle: Allow browser and device streaming from {{machine}}

access.title: Apps with access
access.description: Browsers and apps that came in through an account.
access.listFailed: Could not list the clients with access
access.empty: Nothing else has access to this machine.

silent.label: Not answering
silent.description: The list loads once the machine is back.

confirm.title: Revoke {{label}}?
confirm.current: This is the client you are using. It loses access to this machine and forgets it here.
confirm.statement: It loses access the next time it connects, and signing in through an account will not let it back in.
confirm.link: It loses access the next time it connects.

machineDialog.addFailed: {{machine}} was not added to your account

notOpened.title: Not opened on this client
notOpened.label: Open it to change its name, icon and connection
notOpened.canOpen: It connects through the broker, on the strength of your account.
notOpened.noBroker: This machine is not connected to a broker yet, so it can only be reached on its own network.

identity.title: Name and icon
identity.description: Every client that reaches this machine sees these.

account.title: Account
account.registrationFailure: Could not update this machine on your account: {{reason}}

addAgain.label: Add to your account again
addAgain.description: Someone took this machine off your account, so it does not join on its own.

account.onYours: This machine is on your account
account.onAnother: This machine is on another account
account.onNone: This machine is on no account yet

leave.description: A machine is on one account. Leaving it cuts off every client that came in through an account.

confirmLeave.title: Take {{machine}} off its account?
confirmLeave.description: Every client that came in through an account loses access now, and none gets in until the machine joins an account again.

forget.label: Forget on this client
forget.description: Drops this machine's row here. The machine, your account and other clients keep theirs.

account.label: Remove from account
account.local: Every other client signed in to your account drops this machine. It stays here, since this app runs on it.
account.description: Every client signed in to your account drops this machine. The app on that machine puts it back.

confirmForget.title: Forget {{machine}} on this client?
confirmForget.description: Its sessions and projects stay on the machine. To get it back here, open it from your account.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {{machine}} from your account?
confirmRemove.description: Every client signed in to your account drops it the next time it refreshes. Clients that are signed out keep it. The machine keeps the clients it let in.

machineDialog.subtitle: {{reach}} · {{version}}

machines.title: Machines

empty.label: No machines yet
empty.description: Add one to open its projects, terminals and agents from here.

machines.mismatch: A different machine answers for this one. Forget it here and open it from your account again.

account.title: Sign-in
account.description: Machines on your account open from any client you sign in on.

unavailable.label: Signing in works in the desktop app and at station.ruimte.app.
unavailable.description: The account sends a sign-in back to those places only.

signedOut.label: Not signed in
signedOut.description: Once you sign in, the machine this app runs on joins your account on its own, and the account's machines show up here.

signingIn.label: Signing in
signingIn.description: Finish signing in in the browser, then come back here.

account.onlyIdentity: {{detail}}. The only way to sign in to this account, so it stays until you add another.
account.finishWith: Finish signing in with {{provider}}, then come back here.
account.notAdded: Not added. Add it to open this account with {{provider}} as well.

delete.label: Delete account
delete.description: Deletes this account and every sign-in to it. Your machines and their projects stay.
delete.title: Delete your Ruimte account?
delete.intro: This cannot be undone. Deleting it removes:

goes.account: The account and the ways to sign in to it.
goes.sessions: Every sign-in to it, on every device.
goes.push: Notifications to your phones and tablets.
goes.machines: Your machines from the account. This computer's machine leaves it now; take any other off on that machine itself before it joins another account. Each keeps its projects.

delete.fieldWord: This account has no name. Type {{word}} to confirm

add.title: Add a machine
add.description: A machine joins through your account. On that machine, run `npx ruimte login`, or open the Ruimte app there and sign in. It shows up here once it is on your account.
add.codeHint: For a machine without the app that ran `ruimte login`
add.withCode: Link a machine with a code

machines.failed: The account settings failed to render

apple.label: Enable Apple Foundation Models
apple.description: Use the model on this Mac for chats and tools. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 26.4 or later, and Apple Intelligence.
apple.toggleDescription: Turning this off stops active Apple chats and pending tool approvals on this machine.
apple.tools: Model inference stays on this Mac. Web searches, page requests and MCP tools can send data to their configured services after approval.
apple.unavailable: The local model is not available.
apple.updateRequired: Update Ruimte on this machine to configure Apple Foundation Models.
apple.saveFailed: Could not change Apple Foundation Models
apple.requiresMac: Requires a Mac with Apple silicon.

login.needsCanvas: Open a canvas to log in. The login runs in a terminal node on it.
